message.content: Based on the conversation, Viper mentioned a strategy to increase their stamina. Specifically, Viper suggested incorporating interval training into their cardio routines. This type of training involves alternating periods of high-intensity exercise with lower-intensity recovery periods. Viper noted that this method is effective because it builds endurance without overstressing the body, and it keeps workouts interesting. Viper emphasized that one should start with shorter intervals and gradually increase the intensity and duration as their stamina improves. This approach aligns with the broader discussion about maintaining and improving stamina among the participants.
